days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: I can do 141 P with delivery in 0 days. Every round costs us both, so let's close.
Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 88 P with delivery on day 0.
Thanks for your offer. I can come down to 124 P with delivery on day 0.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 117 P, delivery on day 1, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 120 P with delivery on day 3.
